info.name: EMS Reinigungsservice — Mobile & Admin API
info.description:
Field-crew walkthrough of the EMS mobile app plus the admin endpoints exercised by it.

HOW TO RUN
1. Set the `base_url` variable (default http://localhost:8000).
2. Set `email` / `password` to a Vorarbeiter or Administrator account.
3. Send ANY request. The collection-level pre-request script logs in automatically
   and writes the Sanctum token into `{{token}}`, so you never paste a token by hand.
4. `{{order_id}}` is auto-filled by the first successful call in "Today's Tasks".

EXPECTED STATUS CODES
Every request lists its expected code in the name and in the "Tests" tab.
Requests prefixed [NEG] are negative paths and are EXPECTED to fail — a 2xx there
is a bug, not a pass.

KNOWN CONTRACT NOTES
- The order-scoped photo endpoint takes `stage=before|after` and stores PATHS,
  not file bodies. The app uploads to storage first and sends URLs.
- `key_returned` is only enforced when the site has `has_key_safe`, and
  `alarm_activated` only when it has `has_alarm_system`. A site with neither
  closes with `windows_closed` alone.
- If the shift was started with GPS, the closing call MUST send
  `gps_work_end_lat` / `gps_work_end_lng` or it returns 422.

3 · Execution Workflow — 5 Steps
item.description: The whole field cycle in order. Run these top to bottom on one order: 3.1 starts the shift, 3.2/3.3 bracket the break, 3.4–3.8 gather the evidence, 3.9 files the complaint, 3.10 closes the job. Step 3.10 refuses to succeed until everything before it is done — that is by design, not a bug.
